title: Tanzanian Chicken Pilau
community: The more affordable celebration pilau — enjoyed nationwide
author: Mama Salima
desc: Tanzanian Chicken Pilau — fragrant spiced rice cooked with bone-in chicken pieces and Zanzibar spices. The more accessible celebration pilau — full Zanzibar spice character, deeply satisfying, and perfect for family celebrations and special occasions.
longDesc: Chicken pilau is the celebration rice dish that more families can afford than goat or beef pilau — but it carries all the fragrance, warmth, and joy of the full Zanzibar spice experience. It is served at birthdays, graduation celebrations, and family gatherings across Tanzania.
steps: Toast spices. Grind half. Keep half whole.
Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, both spices, tomatoes. Cook 8 minutes.
Return chicken. Add stock. Simmer covered 30 minutes until tender.
Remove chicken pieces. Add drained rice to broth.
Place chicken back on rice for last 5 minutes.
chefTips: Bone-in chicken gives the most flavour to the broth and rice.
Measure the broth after chicken cooking — adjust for the rice.
Placing chicken back on rice perfumes it from above.
cookingScience: See TZA003 for pilau cooking science. Chicken releases glutamates into the cooking liquid — these umami compounds infuse the rice during the steam absorption, producing a richer flavour than plain water would.
culturalNote: Chicken pilau is Tanzania's most democratic celebration dish — the fragrant spiced rice that brings the full joy of the pilau tradition to families of every income level.
